Grimmory library to refresh when Chaptarr imports, renames or deletes audiobook files. Leave unset to ignore audiobooks
Push Chaptarr's metadata for a book to Grimmory, locking the pushed fields there, whenever the book is imported, retagged, or its metadata changes in Chaptarr
Push Covers
Push Chaptarr's cover image for a book to Grimmory whenever the book is imported, retagged, or its cover changes in Chaptarr
Forward Grimmory Edits

Forward metadata and cover edits made in Grimmory to other connections that accept library edits. Requires Grimmory's sidecar 'write on update' setting so edits appear as sidecar files Chaptarr can watch for. Grimmory only writes sidecars when it runs with DISK_TYPE=LOCAL; on network storage the setting is hidden and nothing is forwarded
